title: SUNET ALM and OTDR fibre monitoring map
description: A UPI map of SUNET's description of Advanced Link Monitoring and Optical Time Domain Reflectometry for locating disturbances or breaks along optical fibre.
definitions: OTDR infers distance along a fibre from the round-trip delay of backscattered or reflected optical signals.
ALM denotes continuous link monitoring in the cited SUNET infrastructure context.
assumptions: The measured delay is a round trip, giving the factor one half.
The group index and instrument calibration are known for quantitative localization.
The public SUNET article establishes reported operational use, not independent instrument calibration.

evidence.notes: SUNET reports continuous measurements and remote localization of fibre disturbances; exact publication date and direct-payload hash remain to be independently recaptured.

primary_sources: SUNET: Vi installerar ALM p? samtliga delstr?ckor i Sunets n?t
falsification_conditions: A controlled link test in which calibrated round-trip delay does not track reflector or break distance within declared uncertainty falsifies the quantitative localization model.
The SUNET-specific deployment claim is falsified if an authoritative revision or inventory shows ALM was not deployed as described.
confusion_guard: A public operational report is not a calibration certificate. OTDR localization measures optical path delay and scattering/reflection; it does not directly inspect every physical cause of a fault.
